endorsements.label: Rise of the Hypebots: Scripting Streetwear
endorsements.description: Buying Supreme is even harder when most of your competitors are AI. The era of bot purchasing has arrived and more often than not, purchasing shoes, shirts, and swag, requires shell scripting. We will look at how simplistic (and how complicated) purchasing bots have become, how to write them, and what companies are trying to do to fight them, and why they’re failing at conquering the machines.
